name: Hyacinth Mushroom
summary: In Shadowglen, Hyacinth Mushrooms grow among Teldrassil’s trees and roots. Night elf herbalists use them in medicine, while grell and grellkin forage for them.

sections.title: Flora of Shadowglen
sections.body: Among the trees and roots of Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Hyacinth Mushrooms help forest healers treat young night elf sentinels and trainees harmed by venomous creatures. The spiders of Shadowthread Cave are among the dangers they face. Healers use the mushrooms in soothing draughts and antivenoms. Corrupted grell also hoard them.

faq.q: What are Hyacinth Mushrooms used for?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine uses Hyacinth Mushrooms to make an antidote for Iverron, a young night elf poisoned by venomous spiders while exploring Shadowthread Cave.
In Shadowglen on Teldrassil, Hyacinth Mushrooms grow on the ground near large tree trunks and roots, and beside boulders.

faq.q: Why do the grell carry Hyacinth Mushrooms?
faq.answer: Grell and grellkin forage for Hyacinth Mushrooms in southern Shadowglen and hoard them in their camps.
No. Local healers safely use Hyacinth Mushrooms in healing poultices and antivenoms.

angles.text: You need no formal training to gather these fungi in Shadowglen. As a fledgling herbalist, you can learn how they help counter forest toxins.
As a young night elf training in Shadowglen, you can gather wild plants like Hyacinth Mushrooms to help sustain your kin.
